6977: Sawako is a shy and honest high school girl who in search of friendship, though her resemblance to Sadako from _The Ring_ makes this difficult. Sawako tends to take things too literally and often over-analyzes situations.
13531: Kazehaya is Sawako's outgoing classmate and friend. He is so popular that during middle school, so many girls liked him that they formed a "Kazehaya is Everyone's" Alliance in order to maintain some level of peace among his admirers.
13532: Yoshida Chizuru is another close friend of Sawako. She is the energetic girl of the group.
13533: Ayane is a close friend of Sawako. She is the arguably the most mature of the group and she has a boyfriend in college as well as having her ears pierced multiple times.
13534: Sanada Ryuu is also one of Sawako's new group. He is quiet most of the time, but can still communicate well with Sawako (as they both don't talk much anyways). He is a close childhood friend with Chizuru.
13535: Arai Kazuichi is the temporary homeroom teacher for the gang's class. He is nicknamed Pin and always is called that way (except Sawako who obeys the formalities and still calls him Arai-sensei).
16725: Tōru is Ryu's older brother by eight years and Chizuru's crush since she was young. Although he is Ryu's brother and they resemble one another, their personalities are nearly opposite.
17874: A student in Sawako's class during second year who sits next to her. When Sawako befriends Miura, Kazehaya becomes jealous of him as a potential rival for Sawako. He is interested in girls, particularly Sawako.
28461: A classmate of Sawako. After Sawako begins to open up, Hirano becomes one of her first friends. Her nickname is "Ekko".
29975: The original home room teacher of Sawako's class. He and Pin have the same surname, but are not related. To distinguish between the two teachers Yoshiyuki Arai is called "Zen". "Zen" is an alternate reading of the kanji for "Yoshi".
29976: Yuka is a classmate that has gossiped about Sawako. Eventually, she ends up bullying her in the school bathroom when Sawako was brave enough to them to tell her that the rumors being spread are fake, which causes an uproar among the students.
29981: The only link to Sawako's past, Shino was her middle school classmate and the only person who Sawako talks to as the series begins. Shino cares about Sawako and whether she is fitting into high school.
30264: One of Sawako's classmates, easily swayed by other people. He generally appears in the background. Jounouchi is very attached to Kazehaya, which usually results in him unwittingly interrupting conversations between Sawako and Kazehaya.
39586: She sits behind Sawako after winter break in the first year.
39587: He sits next to Sawako after the Winter break in the first year. He starts conversations with her and tells her that he gets sleep paralysis often.
